title: Round 1 verdicts: four MSPs green, recorder, voice-peaks and windows-reminder-guard loop to amendments
context: Review round 1 ran on all seven MSPs from rendered briefs (code-reviewer and conformance-auditor on each, security-reviewer on voice-peaks and windows-reminder-guard), then candidates, validator, record and verdict per MSP. Green: day-card-playback (U1 LOW), settings-panel-colours (C1, A1, U1, U2 LOW), release-notes (C1, C2, U1 LOW), restart-splash-text (C1 HIGH rejected at bar: bodySans line height 1.45 grows the splash column 15 px; A1 LOW). Loop: recorder (C1 MEDIUM, kind 'onset baseline reset on pause': the Comets model hears a fake 0 on pause so a steady voice fires a false onset on resume), voice-peaks (S1 MEDIUM, kind 'decoder crash on hostile audio': a NaN sample rate traps the macOS decoder and the backfill retries it each launch), windows-reminder-guard (C1 HIGH, kind 'test omits criterion expected': the 16.34 test asserts no title or body and its Android pass never reaches the Android path). The combined recorder plus voice-peaks tree passed capture, entry_cards, log_viewer, accessibility, app and data folders. The Windows PC is offline.
options: Amend the original spec once per loop MSP, one after another: recorder as amendment 1, voice-peaks as amendment 2, windows-reminder-guard as amendment 3
Fold all three blockers into one amendment
Ship now with the three blockers listed as Unresolved
option_reasons: The pipeline rule amends per loop MSP and runs the amendments one after another; recorder goes first because voice-peaks is stacked on it, so its fix merges into voice-peaks before that MSP's own amendment builds.
The rule names one amendment per MSP with that MSP's write-set and its own U+003Cmsp>-amend-U+003Ca> MSP; one amendment would cross write-sets and break the per-MSP round accounting.
Only a stop verdict ships blockers as Unresolved; these are loop verdicts with clear, small fixes.
outcome: Amend per loop MSP in order: amendment 1 recorder (C1), amendment 2 voice-peaks (S1), amendment 3 windows-reminder-guard (C1), each through interphase:prototype on the original spec with that round's verdict.json as the only concerns, built with U+003Chome>/amend-U+003Ca>.zsh (--plan-only first), merged into the MSP branch and its stacked MSPs, then reviewed as round 2. The four green MSPs are reviewed no further. Device checks for 16.20 and 16.28 run in the VM lab alongside the builds.
